clips.title: The story
paras: Claiming Gath'Ilzogg's severed head proves the Blackrock warlord has been slain. His fall breaks the leadership behind the siege of Stonewatch Keep and brings desperate relief to Lakeshire.

Gath'Ilzogg led the Blackrock assault that took Stonewatch Keep, drove out its defenders, and left the valley under constant raids. Lakeshire stood near ruin, while Stormwind sent almost no military help. Magistrate Solomon offered a bounty on the warlord. Gath'Ilzogg fell in the keep's fortified upper levels, and claiming his head breaks the local Blackrock leadership. For Lakeshire, it is the first step toward reclaiming the keep for the kingdom.
